context:
Evaluating a Coralogix support response for this user question:

We instrumented our agent and put gen_ai.input.messages and gen_ai.output.messages on the invoke_agent span. AI Center lists the application and shows cost, but every conversation is empty. Content capture is on. Why?

checklist.name: inference-span-required
checklist.description: Explains that AI Center renders messages only from inference spans (chat, text_completion, generate_content) and that each model call needs its own chat span carrying the messages.

checklist.name: invoke-agent-metadata-only
checklist.description: States that invoke_agent (and invoke_workflow, create_agent, embeddings, retrieval) are treated as metadata-only, so content placed there is not rendered.

checklist.name: no-wrong-cause
checklist.description: Does not blame archive lag, the content-capture switch or attribute size as the cause. FAIL if it suggests waiting or re-enabling capture instead of moving the messages to chat spans.
